completion.reason: The official original vector rendered with weak dark-theme contrast: fine green crossing is difficult to distinguish at small size. An alternate white backing was explored, but the same-color vector was not verified in that presentation; the different-color official app icon cannot establish it. currency.basis: The bank homepage and Grupo Elektra homepage were retrieved on 2026-11-24 and show the bank and logo in active website use; this is not a claim about a formal brand guideline.

identity.basis: The Mexican Banco Azteca homepage identifies the bank and Grupo Elektra's homepage displays the SVG as Banco Azteca and links to that bank site.

assessment.independenceRationale: The bank and its corporate group's sites are related official sources, not independent corroboration. Wikimedia Commons credits Grupo Elektra and serves byte-identical artwork, so it is a copy, not an independent artwork source.
uncertainties: The bank's raster and corporate vector differ in red and green shades; exact color equivalence is not established.
Standalone extraction and theme legibility require final-byte visual and converter checks; the vector was published as a full lockup.

variant.basis: The corporate vector contains a complete red-disc and green crossed-curve symbol, separable from the wordmark; the bank's own footer raster depicts the same general emblem. The vector has no backing behind the symbol, so the prepared standalone symbol retains transparency; exact candidate suitability on both themes remains for actual final renderer review.

candidate.rationale: The bank-linked corporate site directly publishes an original vector containing the complete bank symbol; the bank's current touch icon separately shows the standalone symbol in different colors. Extraction and final quality remain to be checked.

proposal.reason: Current corporate original vector supplies a separable complete bank symbol for preparation; no accepted icon exists at the frozen base according to the work order. This is not final candidate approval.
